entities.name: UAC-0010
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage threat group also known as Armageddon or Gamaredon.

entities.name: GammaLoad.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based malware downloader used by the Gamaredon group to deliver subsequent payloads.

entities.name: GammaSteel.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell script used by Gamaredon to search for and exfiltrate specific files.

entities.name: GammaSteel.NET
entities.gloss: A .NET-based infostealer malware used by Gamaredon to steal credentials from web browsers.

entities.name: HarvesterX
entities.gloss: A legacy data-harvesting malware tool previously utilized by Gamaredon.

entities.name: Normal.dotm
entities.gloss: The default macro-enabled template file for Microsoft Word.

entities.name: powershell.exe
entities.gloss: The command-line shell and scripting tool executable for Microsoft Windows PowerShell.

entities.name: wscript.exe
entities.gloss: The Windows Script Host executable used to run VBScript and JScript files.

entities.name: mshta.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Windows utility used to execute Microsoft HTML Application (HTA) files.
